description: Unit tests for the HttpBasicState class in the net/http module, testing construction, connection management, initialization, traffic annotation, parser deletion, and request line generation with and without proxy.

classes.name: HttpBasicState
classes.description: Class representing the state of an HTTP basic connection, including connection management, parser handling, and request line generation.

methods.name: ConstructsProperly
methods.description: Test that HttpBasicState is constructed correctly with a socket handle and proxy usage flag.

methods.name: ConstructsProperlyWithDifferentOptions
methods.description: Test construction with different proxy options.

methods.name: ReleaseConnectionWorks
methods.description: Test that releasing the connection returns the correct socket handle and resets the connection.

methods.name: InitializeWorks
methods.description: Test that the Initialize method sets up the parser correctly.

methods.name: TrafficAnnotationStored
methods.description: Test that traffic annotation is stored correctly in the state.

methods.name: DeleteParser
methods.description: Test that the parser can be deleted and set to nullptr.

methods.name: GenerateRequestLineNoProxy
methods.description: Test request line generation when not using a proxy.

methods.name: GenerateRequestLineWithProxy
methods.description: Test request line generation when using a proxy.
